changelog: Authenticated `GET /api/support-bundle` exports an attachable JSON snapshot with installed/published versions,
The bundle is allowlist-only and excludes settings, logs, secrets, credentials, PII, audio, and raw SIP.
Adversarial tests inject tokens, email, phone, IP, SIP URIs, and connection strings and require zero leakage.
changelog_es: bundle saneado para tickets de soporte
Nuevo `GET /api/support-bundle`: toma en solo lectura la salud operativa autenticada y produce un JSON adjuntable
La salida usa allowlist estricta: excluye settings, logs, secretos, credenciales, PII, audio y SIP raw; el token
